mintAuthority.summary: eMXN is issued by Telcoin LLC on Polygon under the eXYZ terms, separately from Telcoin Digital Asset Bank's eUSD. The token's proxy upgrade and mint roles are controlled by Safe multisigs; at the reviewed block the primary minter is 3-of-6, the default-admin/minter is 2-of-7, and the proxy-admin owner is 3-of-6.

review.evidence: Verified at Polygon block 88324188. TransparentUpgradeableProxy at 0x68727e573d21a49c767c3c86a92d9f24bd933c99; impl = 0x486b5d5760e8e98df2c9fc24f09b2d76893aa1de (Stablecoin contract). Proxy admin Safe (6/3) at 0x6eaa439f (masterCopy 0x3e5c63 Gnosis Safe L2 1.3.0, no modules, no guard). MINTER_ROLE active holders: 0xa28b90d4 (Safe 1.3.0 L2, 6/3) and 0xbf58e5b1 (Safe 1.3.0 L2, 5/2, also holds DEFAULT_ADMIN). RoleGranted events scanned via Blockscout; no RoleRevoked events found. All three Safes have no modules or guards. Mint-tier review (2026-07-15): No independent attestor, cadence, or dated eMXN reserve report is public; Telcoin's Digital Cash page promises future monthly attestations. Nebraska Department of Banking and Finance records match Telcoin Digital Asset Bank as a chartered digital-asset depository, so prudential supervision exists but independent reconciliation remains unknown. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: Telcoin Safes can mint and replace mint logic without delay, promised monthly attestations are not yet published, and Nebraska NDBF prudentially supervises the chartered issuer.
